About The Job Nutanix Engineer/ Networking IT Support Engineer
 Nutanix Engineer / Networking IT Support Engineer (Break & Fix Support)
 Location: Brasov, Romania ﻿
 Employment Type: Freelance (On-Call Basis)
 Priority: High (Immediate Hiring)
 Role Overview
 We are seeking an experienced Nutanix Engineer / Networking IT Support Engineer to provide Break & Fix support services across enterprise infrastructure environments. This freelance, on-call role requires a highly skilled professional who can diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, network, and infrastructure-related incidents efficiently while maintaining a high level of customer service and professionalism.
The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Nutanix and networking technologies, hold a valid CCNA certification, and demonstrate excellent communication skills with fluent English proficiency.
 Key Responsibilities
 Provide onsite and remote Break & Fix support for networking and infrastructure-related incidents.
 Deploy, configure, and manage Nutanix HCI environments (AOS, AHV, Prism).
 Perform system upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management activities.
 Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, virtualization, and network issues.
 Diagnose and resolve network connectivity problems involving TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and related technologies.
 Implement and support backup and disaster recovery solutions.
 Respond to critical incidents and service requests within agreed response times.
 Collaborate with global and regional teams on infrastructure and cloud-related projects.
 Maintain accurate technical documentation, incident reports, and service records.
 Ensure professional interaction with end users, stakeholders, and customers at all times.
 Required Skills & Experience
 Minimum 5 years of experience in infrastructure, virtualization, networking, or IT support engineering.
 Strong hands-on experience with the Nutanix ecosystem (AOS, AHV, Prism).
 Experience supporting VMware and/or Hyper-V environments.
 Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, and switching.
 Proven experience providing Break & Fix support in enterprise environments.
 Ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and networking issues.
 Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions.
 Scripting experience with PowerShell and/or Python is advantageous.
 Mandatory Requirements
 Valid CCNA Certification (Cisco Certified Network Associate).
 Minimum 90% pass score on the induction assessment.
 Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).
 Ability to work independently in customer-facing environments.
 Professional demeanor and strong customer service orientation.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Nutanix Certification (NCP or higher).
 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
 Knowledge of automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform.
 Experience supporting enterprise networking infrastructure.
 Soft Skills
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
 Strong professionalism and customer-facing skills.
 Ability to remain calm and effective during critical incidents.
 Proactive problem-solving mindset.
 Strong organizational and time-management skills.
 Ability to work collaboratively within distributed teams.
 Commitment to delivering high-quality technical support and customer satisfaction.
